description: This file contains implementation of functions related to firewall rule configuration, including getting and setting ICMP types, source MAC addresses, and time span parameters. It also defines specific data structures for firewall rule objects and parameters, indicating its role in a firewall configuration system.

methods.name: int get_rule_icmp_type(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves ICMP type values assigned to a specific firewall rule section.

methods.name: int get_rule_source_mac(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the source MAC address from the firewall rule configuration section.

methods.name: int get_time_span_supported_days(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns supported days for time span rule.

methods.name: int get_time_span_days(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the weekday configuration for a time span rule.

methods.name: int get_time_span_start_time(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the start time for a time span rule.

methods.name: int get_time_span_stop_time(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the stop time for a time span rule.

methods.name: int set_rule_icmp_type(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the ICMP type values in the firewall rule section.

methods.name: int set_rule_source_mac(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the source MAC address for a firewall rule.

methods.name: int set_time_span_supported_days(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets supported days for a time span rule (currently TODO).

methods.name: int set_time_span_days(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the weekdays parameter for a time span rule.

methods.name: int set_time_span_start_time(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the start time for a time span rule.

methods.name: int set_time_span_stop_time(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the stop time for a time span rule.

methods.name: int test__get_firewall_expriydate(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns a fixed expiry date string for firewall rules.
